description:
Bridge ACTION lines in notes and logs into anchored TASK lines, and mutate those anchors.

Subcommands:
  (no subcommand) [--dry-run] [--quiet] — walk notes/ and logs/, validate every ACTION line, rewrite each in place as a TASK anchor with a fresh 8-char uuid
  add THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — buffer-append a structured ACTION (delegates to `buffer add-action`)
  done UUID — flip source TASK to DONE and stamp end with today's date
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the anchor body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set due date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set scheduled date, YYYY-MM-DD
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M or L; written as [#X] in the visible portion
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — add a depends entry
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a depends entry
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] — list pending tasks
  next — top 5 pending tasks by priority, due, entry
  show UUID — detail view of one anchor

Flags:
  top-level (default invocation only): --dry-run show what would be ingested without writing; --quiet suppress per-action output
  add: --due YYYY-MM-DD; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-char uuid prefix, repeatable
  list: --priority one of H, M, L; --thread thread label such as Processes/SGB; --assignee person name; --overdue only tasks due before today

Examples:
  []
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send the quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list", "--priority", "H", "--overdue"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]

Notes:
  UUID arguments are prefixes of the 8-char anchor id; an ambiguous or unmatched prefix exits 1.
  `add` only stages an ACTION in the buffer; it does not create an anchor. The anchor exists after `buffer flush` and a bare `tasks` ingest run.
  Ingest rewrites note and log files in place. Use --dry-run first when unsure.
  Assignees must resolve to people/<person>.md; a task cannot depend on itself; empty descriptions are rejected. All exit 1.
  TASK lines are machine-written — mutate them only through these subcommands.
